facts.description: Returned sync arrow sets async false, calls schema._zod.run with value and empty issues, throws new core.$ZodAsyncError on written instanceof Promise guard.
After the guard, issues.length selects failure(_Err, result.issues, ctx); otherwise object has success true and data result.value.
Local error initially undefined; object success false; getter constructs through Err and finalizeIssue only if !error, clears issues and ctx after construction completes, then returns error.
Setter assigns supplied e to error then clears issues and ctx. Getter later checks truthiness; declared TS type is not a runtime validation guard.
Returned async arrow sets async true, calls run and awaits result only when instanceof Promise, then returns the same written failure/success ternary shape.
Core exported constants call the respective factories with errors.$ZodRealError. This does not certify all public import paths.
